title: Open subschemes of a fibre product
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes with fibre product $X\times_SY$ and projections $p,q$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $U\subseteq S$, $V\subseteq X$, $W\subseteq Y$ be open subschemes with $f(V)\subseteq U$ and $g(W)\subseteq U$. Then the canonical morphism $V\times_UW\to X\times_SY$ (induced by the inclusions) is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] whose image is $p^{-1}(V)\cap q^{-1}(W)$; so $V\times_UW$ is identified with the open subscheme $p^{-1}(V)\cap q^{-1}(W)$, compatibly with the projections.
